text:
🇫🇷 I asked 4 AI models to take me back to Paris in 1996. 100% code. 🇫🇷

Same prompt, one-shot:
Opus 5.5: $73.80 · 2h56m
Gemini 4 Argon: ~$2.50 · 30m
DeepSeek Flash 1017: $0.34 · 46m
Grok 4.7: ~$7 · 2h07m

Opus nailed the vibe, but DeepSeek got almost on its level for 217x less 🤯 https://t.co/D0KTSW315S
model_or_tool: Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, DeepSeek Flash 1017, Grok 4.7
what_they_built: A one-shot, all-code 3D recreation of Paris in 1996, built side by side by four different AI models.

text:
I built a realistic ant colony simulator.

Drop something sweet on the kitchen counter, like a sugar cube, and ants come out of the wall to find it.

Click on any ant to follow her. You can also see inside the nest to watch the queen, eggs and larvae.

Made with Claude Opus 5.5. https://t.co/RzaWqyzAV5
what_they_built: A realistic ant colony simulator where ants leave the wall to find sugar and you can look inside the nest.

You sail a little boat around an autumn lake and collect glowing kanji floating over the things they mean. Mountain, temple, lake, leaves.

I made it with Claude Opus 5.5 
It cost me $6 to bring this idea to life.

Play it  here👇 https://t.co/OyRuh0nFwk
